plan.title: Modules 2-3: Installation, Project Anatomy, Authority, and Context

narratives.Description: Deliver two substantive, self-directed core modules: Module 2 teaches version-pinned consumer installation, initialization, diagnosis, project anatomy, and safe recovery in a disposable repository; Module 3 teaches authority resolution, behavior-versus-requirement boundaries, and lazy loading through a fictional conflict exercise.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer new to Directive, I want reproducible setup and authority-resolution practice, so that I can orient inside a Directive consumer project and recover from common mistakes without undocumented assistance.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Revalidate setup, command, authority, and lazy-loading claims against @deftai/directive 0.111.0 and its released sources.
2. Build Module 2, a disposable initialization lab, its cross-platform proof path, and an explained solution.
3. Build Module 3, its progressively hinted fictional authority exercise, and an explained solution.
4. Refresh course navigation and reference material, add a focused content verifier, and run the literal and aggregate gates.
5. Keep any unproved operating-system, shell, package-manager, or host path labeled candidate or omit it until evidence exists.
narratives.Acceptance: Module 2 lets a learner choose among init, update, and doctor; use the exact pinned consumer path; distinguish consumer and maintainer surfaces; classify tracked, ignored, authoritative, and reconstitutable artifacts; interpret doctor findings without assuming warning-free output; and recover safely in a disposable repository. Module 3 lets a learner resolve USER.md, PROJECT-DEFINITION, task guidance, active scope plus live intent, and framework defaults; separate behavior rules from product requirements; and load only relevant guidance. Both modules satisfy the repository's self-directed module contract and require no instructor, external review bot, credential, production repository, or remote mutation.
narratives.KnownReleasedBehavior: A 2026-09-05 macOS/zsh probe of @deftai/directive 0.111.0 found that init after git init classified the empty Git repository as brownfield and did not create the package.json pin described by released prose. doctor exited 0 with pin/provenance warnings and also reported a missing xbrief directory while inspecting an existing xBRIEF envelope. The curriculum must record this disagreement, teach an explicit exact-version pin before initialization, and classify doctor evidence rather than promise zero warnings.
narratives.PlatformProof: macOS/zsh has direct runtime evidence. Linux/bash and native Windows/PowerShell 7 require independent execution before those paths are labeled verified. A small GitHub Actions matrix may provide the native operating-system proof; creating or running remote CI still requires the repository's separate push/PR authorization. PowerShell on macOS is not proof of native Windows behavior. pnpm remains candidate-only unless separately executed.
narratives.Safety: All executable setup work uses a unique operating-system temporary directory containing fictional data and no Git remote. Guards must prove the canonical working root equals the recorded lab root before mutation. Reset defaults to a fresh disposable directory while preserving failure evidence; cleanup must target one exact verified no-remote lab path. Never initialize, reset, or clean this training worktree, a business repository, a home directory, or a broad workspace.
narratives.Traces: PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: installation and project orientation; authority and lazy loading. SupportedEnvironments, LabModel, DirectiveBaseline, SourceOfTruth, ProjectRules, and PublishingBoundary.
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance commands; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands. A platform path is not verified merely because the content verifier passes.

acceptance.derived_reason: decomposed the operator-approved Modules 2-3 outcomes and self-directed content contracts into artifact-bound, independently inspectable clauses

clauses.text: references/SOURCE-BASELINE.md records the exact Directive 0.111.0 pin, official release tag and commit, Modules 2-3 source files/headings, tested command surfaces, adaptation status, and prose-versus-runtime disagreements.

references/SOURCE-NOTES.md contains dated environment and result records for the claimed macOS/zsh, Linux/bash, and Windows/PowerShell 7 setup paths; any unexecuted path is labeled candidate or omitted, and PowerShell on macOS is not counted as native Windows proof.

.github/workflows/modules-2-3-platform-validation.yml uses pinned actions and a macOS, Linux, and Windows matrix to execute only the disposable Module 2 proof path; it requires no user-managed secret, write permission, persisted credential, or remote mutation. GitHub still supplies its ephemeral read token to the official checkout and Node setup actions.

curriculum/modules/02-installation-and-anatomy.md satisfies the module contract and maps O2.1-O2.4 to a starting check, command chooser, consumer/maintainer boundary, anatomy classification, guided walkthrough, lab, evidence, hints, recovery, misconceptions, self-assessment, navigation, and official sources.

labs/02-disposable-initialization.md provides exact per-platform tasks, a unique temporary-directory and canonical-root guard, empty-remote check, explicit 0.111.0 package pin, mutation allowlist, checkpoint, literal acceptance commands, expected evidence, progressive hints, tested recovery, fresh-directory reset, bounded cleanup, solution link, and a clear done condition.

labs/fixtures/02-disposable-initialization/package.json is fictional, private, pins @deftai/directive exactly to 0.111.0, and contains no remote, credential, client data, proprietary source, or production integration.

solutions/lab-02-disposable-initialization.md maps O2.1-O2.4 to reasoning, reproducible commands, observed evidence, valid alternatives, known 0.111.0 findings, failure recovery, reset, and cleanup without assuming warning-free doctor output or automatic package pinning.

curriculum/modules/03-authority-and-context.md satisfies the module contract and maps O3.1-O3.4 to a conceptual starting check, accurate two-axis authority model, behavior-versus-requirement teaching, lazy-loading walkthrough, fictional conflict exercise, hints, recovery, self-assessment, evidence, navigation, and official sources.

Module 3 requires a cited decision table that considers deterministic rule strength separately from Personal/Defaults/project authority, preserves active scope plus live implementation intent, and identifies material ambiguity that requires operator direction rather than inventing a total file-order hierarchy.

solutions/module-03-authority-and-context.md maps O3.1-O3.4, explains every conflict decision and source citation, accepts evidence-equivalent alternatives, gives bounded retry guidance, and identifies unresolved material choices requiring operator direction.

README.md, curriculum/README.md, curriculum/modules/01-what-directive-is.md, and solutions/module-01-what-directive-is.md link Modules 1-3, state their accurate readiness and platform support, preserve the cold-start and safety contracts, keep numeric prerequisites, and route Module 3 onward to planned Module 4.

labs/README.md, assessments/README.md, and solutions/README.md link the new practical evidence paths and remove stale blanket-unavailable language without claiming unfinished later modules are available.

references/GLOSSARY.md and references/QUICK-REFERENCE.md define and cross-link the Modules 2-3 terms while keeping Directive behavior, 3Ci policy, course guidance, current xBRIEF 0.8, and legacy material distinct.

scripts/verify-modules-2-3.mjs exits non-zero for missing required artifacts, headings, outcome IDs, platform proof, links, stale availability statements, or unresolved author markers, and passes for the completed scope.

package.json exposes check:modules-2-3 without changing the exact @deftai/directive 0.111.0 development pin or adding an application, static-site generator, publishing system, or large validation framework.

Every executable example uses fictional data in an exact disposable no-remote repository; reset and cleanup cannot target the training repository, a business repository, a home directory, or a broad workspace, and no exercise requires credentials, production access, deployment, publication, an instructor, or a live review bot.

npm run check:cold-start-readme, npm run check:modules-2-3, directive verify:vbrief-conformance --project-root ., and the separately executed task deft:check all pass on the feature branch; the scope is not completed until every claimed platform proof is current.
